title: Ideal quotient for the controlled transform
statement: Let $\sigma:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $I,J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent ideals [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $c\in\mathbf N$. Define the controlled ideal quotient to be the quasi-coherent ideal $\sup\{K\subseteq\mathcal O_Y:K(I\mathcal O_Y)^c\subseteq J\mathcal O_Y\}$, where the supremum is in the complete lattice of quasi-coherent ideal sheaves and products and powers are those of [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. When $I\mathcal O_Y$ is invertible and $J\mathcal O_Y\subseteq(I\mathcal O_Y)^c$, this is the usual regular controlled transform $(I\mathcal O_Y)^{-c}(J\mathcal O_Y)$. The formula by a supremum is the construction, and the latter identification is a separate assertion.
